RSS Chief Warns Against Foreign-Fueled Regime Change Attempts in India

RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat stated on Tuesday that attempts at regime change in India, fueled by a "demonic resolve to destroy all that is decent," will not succeed. Addressing the organization's Vijayadashami gathering in Nagpur, he warned that foreign and domestic forces are seeking to weaken the country by exploiting divisions. Bhagwat cited examples from France, Albania, Nepal, and Bangladesh, suggesting that upheavals in these countries did not lead to improvements. He also indicated that a "storm from the West" is attempting to destabilize India and that protests rarely solve problems. Bhagwat also stated there is "no hesitation" or objection to singing the "Vande Mataram" in its entirety.
